"Lzahlia's Theory of Systems"

An introduction to Lzahlia's [[55]] Propositional Philsophical [[48]] Framework for General Systems [[38]];  of "Cybernetic Lifecycles of Information and Power." 

The "Cybernetic" [[23]] emphasis Systems Lifecycles, corresponds to the fundamental Feedback-Update-Lifecycle [[24]]

This idea suggests a lifecycle, or greater purpose to information or matter.

The problem may not necessarily be of Information Management itself, as Information-Theory [[12]] Mathematically [[52]] proved; Information and Meaning can be decoupled [[15]].  Therefore, the structure of information [[17]] must be independent of Meaning [[41]]
